interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crossing with signage to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians to cross between the food trucks and the building.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Designated Food Truck Zones
interventions.description: Establish dedicated off-street or curb-side zones for food trucks that do not impede the clear walking width of the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clear Zone Enforcement
interventions.description: Implement physical barriers or strict enforcement to ensure a minimum clear path for pedestrians is maintained at all times.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair the cracked and uneven asphalt surface to provide a smooth, accessible walking environment.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style high-visibility crosswalk markings to improve driver awareness of the pedestrian crossing.

interventions.title: Construction Site Management
interventions.description: Ensure clear, ADA-compliant pedestrian bypasses are maintained around construction scaffolding and barriers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk to provide a designated and visible crossing point near the food truck.

interventions.title: Parking Restrictions (Daylighting)
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the food truck to ensure clear sightlines for pedestrians entering the roadway.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical speed control measures to reduce vehicle speeds on this wide residential/institutional street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at potential crossing points to improve visibility and shorten crossing distances.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with appropriate signage and potentially a pedestrian-activated signal to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Dedicated Loading Zones
interventions.description: Designate specific areas for food trucks and commercial loading that do not obstruct pedestrian walkways or sightlines.

interventions.title: Bollards or Planters
interventions.description: Install vertical elements like bollards or large planters to physically protect the pedestrian area and clearly define the edge of the roadway.

interventions.title: Designated Food Truck Zone
interventions.description: Establish a designated, set-back area for food trucks that ensures they do not obstruct pedestrian flow or sightlines at potential crossing points.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Add painted lane lines to narrow the perceived width of the travel lanes and organize traffic flow.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated crossing point for building residents/users.

interventions.title: Parking Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to potential crossing points to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Tables
interventions.description: Implement vertical speed control measures to slow traffic in this institutional/campus zone.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crosswalk
interventions.description: Establish a marked crossing with high-visibility paint and signage to provide a designated space for residents to cross between buildings.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the asphalt to eliminate cracks and uneven patches.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections or potential crossing points to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked mid-block crossing with high-visibility markings and signage if pedestrian demand is high between intersections.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks to designate safe crossing points for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Narrow the driveway entrance on the left to reduce vehicle turning speeds and minimize the conflict area with the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Given the residential density, a high-visibility marked crossing would provide a designated and safer space for pedestrians to cross.

interventions.title: Lane narrowing/markings
interventions.description: Add paint to define travel lanes and parking lanes, which helps to naturally slow traffic speeds.
